title: Degree Bounds for Degenerate Herman Rings
author_candidate: At most d-1 individually invariant Julia-set irrational-rotation Jordan curves, excluding rotation-domain boundaries.
restricted_circular_result: At most one periodic spherical circle with irrational rotation dynamics.
periodic_gap: For periods dividing L, candidate bound d^L-1 depends on L; no degree-only all-period bound established.
literal_source_result: Bare printed exclusions allow infinitely many degree-two Siegel-disk level curves; intended formulation is not declared solved.
